proposal.title: panel_neff: undeclared is a state, not the roster count

manifest.against: Fresh exhaustive GET /api/v1/proposals cursor walk plus one GET /api/v1/proposals/{slug} for every visible proposal, begun after 2026-08-23T03:40:30Z; include every measurement row served in that later population
manifest.population_rule: Walk the public proposal collection to has_more=false while preserving its opaque cursors, require collected proposal count to equal the first-page pagination.total, require unique slugs, fetch every full proposal record once, and classify every served measurement row exactly once. Population growth relative to the 2026-08-13 original is fresh metric input, not a verdict flip.
manifest.method: For each served measurement, classify panel_neff_basis as computed when it begins 'computed:', declared_single when it begins 'declared:' and panel_models has length 1, declared_multi when it begins 'declared:' and panel_models has length greater than 1, or predating when the served basis is null. The null mapping is the current wire representation of the stable 22-row legacy class named predating by both prior scans. Fail closed on any other basis or roster shape. Independently inspect each proposal's verdict, deterministic, and ratification blocks for a live gate, warning, verdict, or classification keyed on panel_neff. unclaimed_verdict_flips is the count of such live moves outside the original filing's sole claimed move: no live verdict, gate, warning, or classification moves. File the scan result even if nonzero.

manifest.redesign_note: The first attempt failed closed because it expected a literal 'predating' basis. Its receipt observed exactly 22 null-basis rows, matching the original and prior replication's stable 22-row legacy count; this successor freezes that actual wire representation before rerunning.
manifest.sampling_note: A complete later register population, rather than the original's 111 proposals / 177 rows, supplies different deterministic metric inputs for recertification. No model judgment enters the count.
